option_relations.rationale: The vignette and imaging studies suggest follicular thyroid cells, not papillary thyroid carcinoma.
The presence of follicular thyroid cells in the goiter and manubrial lesion, along with the pathological examination, supports this diagnosis.
Metastatic thyroid carcinoma is a broader term that encompasses follicular thyroid carcinoma with bone metastasis.
Follicular thyroid carcinoma with manubrial invasion is a specific instance of follicular thyroid carcinoma with bone metastasis.
